blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: People adapt how they talk to the person in front of them. However, chat models tend to respond in Standard English regardless of the dialect used by the user. A uniform answer can hide whether training treats these users alike, and output audits cannot tell as well. We trace how each post-training stage, from supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to preference optimization (DPO) and reinforcement learning, changes a model's tendency to match the user, and read what each update prefers from two content-matched replies, one matching the user and one not. Across 10 open model lineages, post-training standardizes replies to every informal cue, yet after adjusting for how likely each reply already was, the DPO update still favours matching British and Australian spelling over AAE and Singlish on 10 lineages, and models still produce AAE features when asked. We then introduce calibrated accommodation pairs (CAP), preference data that reward matching users' dialect density while preserving Standard English for Standard-English users. On a fully open model, CAP raises convergence on features it was not trained on without a detectable increase in dialect for Standard-English users or a cost in instruction following. In contrast, one-sided pairs reach a similar gain only by overshooting the user and imposing dialect. Our findings show that uniform replies can hide selective updates and audits should read the update as well as the output. Code: https://github.com/kouzhizhuo/cap-accommodation.
blocks.zh: 人们会适应他们如何和面前的人说话. 然而,聊天模式往往以标准英语回应,无论用户使用何种方言. 统一的答案可以隐藏培训是否一视同仁地对待这些用户,产出审计也无法分辨. 我们追踪每个培训后阶段,从有监督的微调(SFT)到偏好优化(DPO)和强化学习,如何改变一个模型与用户匹配的倾向,并阅读每个更新从两个内容匹配的回复中选择的,一个匹配用户,一个不匹配. 在10个开放的模范线条中,培训后将每个非正式线条的答复标准化,然而,在调整了每条线条答复的可能性之后,DPO更新版仍然倾向于在10条线条上将英国和澳大利亚的拼写比作AAE和Singlish,当被问及时,模型仍然产生AAE特征。 然后引入校准住宿配对(CAP),优先数据奖励匹配的用户方言密度,同时为标准英语用户保留标准英语. 在一个完全开放的模型中,CAP提高了对它所训练的特性的趋同,但没有为标准英语用户提供可察觉的方言增加,或者没有随后的教学费用。 相比之下,单面对子只通过过度射击用户和强加方言来达到类似的收益. 我们的调查结果表明,统一的答复可以隐藏有选择的更新,审计应该阅读更新和产出。 代码:https://github.com/kourzhizhuo/cap-acounter.

blocks.en:
A user asks a chatbot for advice: “I usually buy theater tickets for my sister, who keep dragging me to the movies. My boss says the budget been canceled this month. Do y’all have any tips?” ( Figure 1 ; replies in Section C.1.1 )
The request is in African American English (AAE); its Standard-English twin differs only in keeps , has been and you .
People adjust their speech to the person they talk to, converging toward that person’s way of speaking or holding back ( Giles et al., 1991 ) , and deployed chatbots over-converge to their users’ style ( Blevins, 2026 ) .
Yet chat models default to Standard English with speakers of AAE, Singlish and Nigerian English ( Fleisig et al., 2024 ) . Features of these varieties are rare in chatbot traffic and training data ( Section C.2 ).
blocks.zh:
一个用户向一个聊天员咨询:“我通常会为我妹妹买戏院票, 我老板说这个月的预算被取消了 你们有小费吗? (图1;C.1.1节的答复)
要求使用非裔美国人英语,
人们根据自己交谈的人调整他们的演讲,一致接受这个人的演讲方式或退缩方式(Giles等人,1991年),并按用户的风格部署聊天机器人(Brevins,2026年)。
然而聊天模式默认为标准英语,使用AAE, Singlish和尼日利亚英语(Fleisig等, 2024年). 这些品种的特征在聊天室交通和培训数据中是罕见的(C.2节)。

blocks.en:
Instruction-tuned models converge less to dialogue style than pretrained ones ( Blevins et al., 2026 ) , reward models disprefer AAE ( Mire et al., 2025 ) , and dialect gaps accumulate along the training pipeline ( Elle, 2026 ) .
Two questions remain open. First, closed models and base-versus-instruct comparisons cannot tell which stage installs this default: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on standard responses, or preference optimization.
Second, outputs alone cannot tell whether training treats users alike : two models that answer everyone in Standard English may have learned different preferences.
blocks.zh:
与被预先训练的模型相比,被指令调制的模型与对话风格的趋同较少(Blevins等,2026年),奖励模型不适应AAE(Mire等,2025年),而方言差距沿训练管道积累(Elle,2026年).
有2个问题尚未解决。 首先,闭塞模型和基础与指令比较无法分辨安装此默认的阶段:在标准响应上进行有监督的微调(SFT),或优化偏好.
第二,仅靠产出无法判断培训是否对用户一视同仁:用标准英语回答每个人的两个模式可能学到了不同的偏好。

blocks.en:
We read accommodation on two channels at every training stage: the reply (does it converge toward the user’s variety?) and the update (does the training step favour converging?).
We follow 10 open lineages through SFT, direct preference optimization (DPO) and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR); each checkpoint answers requests like the one above, written in several varieties and in Standard English.
We score only reply text not copied from the request, and read each update through the likelihood it gives to two content-matched replies, one that matches the user ( your sister, who keep dragging you ) and one that does not ( who keeps dragging you ).
blocks.zh:
我们在每个培训阶段通过两个渠道阅读住宿:答复(是否与用户的种类一致? ) 和更新(是否与培训步骤一致?
我们通过SFT、直接偏好优化(DPO)和可核查奖励的强化学习(RLVR)来遵循10个开放的行道;每个检查站的回答都像上面的一样,用几个品种和标准的英语写出。
我们只得到没有从请求中复制的回覆文本,并且通过它给两个内容匹配的答复的可能性读取每个更新,一个与用户(你的妹妹,一直拖你)匹配,一个与用户(她不断拖你)匹配.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: ❶ Standard replies, selective updates. Post-training defaults to Standard English, but DPO selectively favors British and Australian spelling over AAE and Singlish on all 10 lineages. ❷ Controlled re-run. Accommodation-consistent pairs boost convergence only at high doses, while undesirably introducing dialect for Standard English users. ❸ Calibrated accommodation pairs. Penalizing under-accommodation, over-accommodation, and imposition in DPO data increases held-out convergence on OLMo-2-1B without dialect insertion. ❹ Diagnostic & benchmark. We introduce a copy-controlled convergence ratio and matching bonus to disentangle output behavior from training preferences ( anonymous code and data ).

Several pre-registered predictions did not hold, including that the split between prestige and stigmatized varieties grows at the preference stage, and that convergence rises gradually with the dose of accommodation-consistent preference pairs; Section D.2 reports every outcome.
Whether a model should reply in a user’s variety is for its speakers to decide ( Sandoval et al., 2025 ) .

blocks.en: 2 Background and Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 背景和有关工作

blocks.en:
Communication Accommodation Theory (CAT) holds that speakers adjust their speech to interlocutors for social reasons ( Giles et al., 1991 ; Giles, 2016 ) . Convergence reduces linguistic differences to seek approval, divergence accentuates them, and maintenance keeps one’s own variety; convergence flows upward, toward the higher-status variety, and a speaker able to converge may choose not to ( Dragojevic et al., 2016 ) .
Priming accounts instead predict convergence to every variety ( Pickering and Garrod, 2004 ) , as in a pretrained model continuing a user’s turn.
Language models converge strongly when completing human dialogues, instruction-tuned ones less ( Blevins et al., 2026 ) ; these studies measure style, we measure the features that distinguish varieties. 1 1 1 We use accommodation in Giles’ sense, not in the pragmatic sense of accommodating an interlocutor’s presuppositions ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
交流住宿理论(CAT)认为,演讲者出于社会原因调整演讲对象(Giles等人,1991年;Giles,2016年)。 趋同会减少语言差异以寻求认可,分歧会加剧,维护会保持自己的多样性;趋同会向上流动,走向地位较高的多样性,能够趋同的演讲者可能会选择不这样做(Dragojevic等,2016年)。
定价账户则预测与每种品种的趋同性(Pickering和Garrod,2004年),如在预先训练的模型中,继续由用户进行。
语言模型在完成人类对话时会强烈地趋同,而指导调取的则较少(Brevins等,2026;这些研究测量风格,我们测量区分品种的特征. 1个 1 我们使用Giles意义上的通融,而不是以务实的方式容纳对话者的预想(Cheng等人,2026年)。

blocks.en:
Standard-language ideology treats one variety as correct and the others as errors ( Milroy, 2001 ; Lippi-Green, 2012 ) . It predicts upward convergence toward the standard and prestige cues such as British spelling, but not toward stigmatized grammar.
Language models show covert prejudice against AAE speakers ( Hofmann et al., 2024 ) , reward models disprefer AAE ( Mire et al., 2025 ) , preference tuning creates dialect disparities ( Ryan et al., 2024 ) , and generative AI is argued to reproduce the ideology ( Smith et al., 2026 ) ; we ask where in training it enters.
blocks.zh:
标准语言意识形态将一种类型视为正确,其他则视为错误(Milroy,2001;Lippi-Green,2012.). 它预示着向上趋同于英国拼写等标准与威望提示,但不向被污名化的语法.
语言模型对AAE演讲者表现出了隐蔽的偏见(Hofmann等,2024年),奖励模型对AAE的贬低(Mire等,2025年),偏好调和会造成方言差异(Ryan等,2024年),基因AI被争论为再现意识形态(Smith等,2026年);我们在训练中询问它进入何处.

blocks.en: DPO makes the log-ratio between the trained and the reference policy an implicit reward ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) . We use the ratio between consecutive released stages descriptively, as an update diagnostic , not an identified reward: compared across content-matched replies, it shows which reply a stage up- or down-weights. We pre-registered predictions from these accounts before the main runs ( Section D.1 ); related work is in Section E.1 .

blocks.en: 4 Replies Converge on Standard English
blocks.zh: 4 标准英语的答复汇合器

blocks.en: As Figure 3 shows that post-training makes replies standard for every user, while the ability to produce dialect features remains.
blocks.zh: 如图3所示,培训后为每个用户制定答复标准,而制作方言特征的能力仍然存在。

blocks.en: 4.1 Post-Training Standardizes Replies to Every Informal Cue
blocks.zh: 4.1 培训后对每个非正式课程的答复标准化

blocks.en:
Post-training standardizes replies to every informal cue ( Table 1 ).
Base OLMo-2-7B reproduces a user’s British spelling at 0.171 (95% CI [0.137, 0.207]); after SFT the rate is 0.120, after DPO 0.058 ([0.040, 0.076]), and RLVR leaves it at 0.060.
Informal register follows the same path (0.413 at base under the chat template, 0.009 after DPO).
The preference stage, with the chat template fixed, lowers convergence to informal register on all 10 lineages and to British spelling on 9 of 10 (stage and framing details in Section C.4 ). The exception is formal register. Replies keep converging to formal requests at every stage (OLMo-2-7B after DPO: 0.141), so post-training not replies formal.
blocks.zh:
培训后使对每一个非正式提示的答复标准化(表1)。
Base OLMo-2-7B以0.171 (95% CI [0.137,0.207])复制了用户的英国拼写;SFT后为0.120,后为DPO0.058 ([0.040,0.076]),RLVR后为0.060.
非正式寄存器遵循相同的路径(在聊天模板下底为0.413,在DPO后为0.009).
选择阶段,即聊天模板固定下来,降低了所有10个行中与非正式登记册的趋同度,也降低了10个行中9个行中与英国拼音的趋同度(阶段和框架细节见C.4节)。 正式登记是例外。 在每个阶段(DPO之后的OLMo-2-7B:0.141),答复都与正式请求一致,因此培训后的答复不是正式的。

blocks.en: Dialect grammar was mirrored only weakly to begin with. Continuing a user’s text, base OLMo-2-7B reproduces AAE features at 0.022 ([0.013, 0.031]) and Singlish lexis at 0.051. After SFT both are near zero, also on human-written AAE tweets ( Section C.1 ).
blocks.zh: Dialect语法最初只是被弱化地反映. 继续一个用户的文本,基站OLMo-2-7B复制了以0.022([0.013,0.031])为单位的AAE特性和以0.051为单位的Singlish lexis. 在SFT之后,

blocks.zh: 威望的订单已经存在于基础模型中. 汇合沿接在基站(OLMo-2-7B上为: ^ 0.778\rho=0.778)和后DPO( ^ 0. 845\rho=0.845): 训练后会降低汇合水平,但不安装订单.

blocks.en: The decline holds at scale and across popular families ( Tables 2 and 4 ).
blocks.zh: 下降的规模和在受欢迎的家庭中(表2和表4)。

blocks.en: From base to final release, informal-register convergence falls in all 12 further families, British-spelling convergence in 9, and AAE ends at most 0.001. Deployed chatbots standardize AAE too, but partly answer Nigerian Pidgin in kind: across 5, convergence is at most 0.053 for informal register and 0.009 for AAE, while British spelling is reproduced at 0.089–0.207 and Nigerian Pidgin at 0.116–0.502, above any post-trained open model (at most 0.046; Table 6 ). In open models, post-training standardizes replies for users of every variety, not singling out stigmatized varieties.
blocks.zh: 从基地到最后发行,非正式登记者汇合在另外所有12个家庭,英国人汇合在9个,AAE最多以0.001结束. 已部署的聊天器也使AAE标准化,但部分地以实物回答尼日利亚的Pidgin:在5个以上,对非正式注册的收缩最多为0.053个,对AAE为0.009个,而英国的拼写为0.089-0.207个,尼日利亚的Pidgin为0.116-0.502个,高于任何经过培训的开放模式(最多为0.046个;表6)。 在开放模式中,培训后将每种品种的用户的答复标准化,而不是单独列出污名化的品种。

blocks.en: 4.2 Models Still Produce AAE Features on Request
blocks.zh: 4.2 应要求仍然生产AAE特性的模型

blocks.en:
Two of three families still produce AAE features at more than half their authentic rate when asked ( Table 12 in Section C.1 ).
Asked to reply in the user’s variety, OLMo-2-7B after DPO realizes AAE features at 0.567 of their authentic rate, against 0.009 in its default replies; Tülu-3-8B behaves alike (0.588).
OLMo-3-7B reaches 0.411; rates are corrected by the blind human audit ( Section C.4 ).
Requested imitation increases stereotyping ( Fleisig et al., 2024 ) , so competence measures ability, not reply quality. AAE features are produced on request in all three families, at more than half their authentic rate in two rarely by default.
blocks.zh:
3个家庭中有2个家庭在被问及时仍以超过半数的实收率生产AAE特征(C.1节表12)。
OLMo-2-7B在DPO意识到AAE特性的真实速率为0. 567后,被要求以用户的品种进行回答,而默认答复为0.009;Tülu-3-8B的表现相同(0.588)。
OLMo-3-7B达到0.411;比率由盲目人审计纠正(C.4节)。
要求的模仿会增加陈规定型(Fleisig等人,2024年),因此能力衡量能力,而不是回复质量. 所有三个家庭都根据要求制作AAE特性,其真实率一半以上是两个家庭很少默认的。

blocks.en: 5 The Update Is Selective
blocks.zh: 5 更新是选择性的

blocks.en: This section shows that, beneath these uniform replies, the DPO update still prefers matching some users over others.
blocks.zh: 本节显示,在这些统一的答复下,DPO更新仍然倾向于匹配一些用户而不是其他用户.

blocks.en: 5.1 The DPO Update Favours Matching Prestige Spelling over Stigmatized Varieties
blocks.zh: 5.1 DPO 更新版本的偏好比对被污名化的品种

blocks.en: Table 3: After adjustment, no update significantly favours stigmatized over prestige matching. Values × \times 100; grey: 95% CI includes 0; adj.: adjusted for baseline likelihood and length.
blocks.zh: 表3:在调整后,没有任何更新明显有利于被污名化的比对。 值×\times 100; 灰色:95% CI包括0; 辅:根据基线概率和长度而调整.

blocks.en:
Within a request, the DPO update favours matching British and Australian spelling over AAE and Singlish on all 10 lineages after adjusting for baseline likelihood and length ( Tables 1 and 2 ).
Pooled over lineages (the analysis fixed at the gate), the contrast is 0.020 nats per token (CI [0.014, 0.027]) and stays positive when any one lineage is left out; the per-lineage fits, made after seeing the 32B data, are all positive. This paired test postdates the pre-registration; the pre-registered mixed model gives a positive tier effect on 9 of 10 lineages but a CI above zero only on 2 ( Section D.2 ).
Per variety ( Table 3 ), the bonus is negative for AAE on 9 of 10 lineages (OLMo-2-7B: − - 0.018, CI [ − - 0.024, − - 0.012]), for Singlish on 6 and for informal register on 6, and not detectably negative for British and Australian spelling on 9.
blocks.zh:
在一项请求中,DPO更新有利于在所有10个行中将英国和澳大利亚的拼写相比于AAE和Singlish,然后根据基线可能性和长度进行调整(表1和表2)。

blocks.en: Raw and adjusted contrasts differ on OLMo-2-32B, whose update up-weights replies the SFT model found unlikely far more than any other: its raw contrast reverses ( − - 0.031) while the adjusted one is positive (0.012); OLMo-3.1-32B does not reverse, so size alone does not explain it ( Section C.4 ). The supervised update shows the same contrast, and RLVR adds little ( Section C.4 ). The contrast also appears within lexical features. Singlish particles and British spelling, both lexical, get opposite signs on 7 of 10 lineages.
blocks.zh: OLMo-2-32B的原始和经调整的对比度不同,其更新的上重值答复SFT模型发现不太可能比任何其他模型多得多:其原始对比值倒数(−--0.031),而经调整的反数为正数(0.012);OLMo-31-32B不倒数,因此单是尺寸并不能解释(C.4节)。 监督更新显示的对比度相同,RLVR增加的很少(C.4节)。 这一对比也出现在词典特征中. Singlish 粒子和英国拼音,两者都是有词性的,在10行中的7行上得到相反的标志.

blocks.en: Popular families point the same way. Across 14 further updates (base to final release in popular families, and SmolLM3’s preference stage), the adjusted contrast is positive in 12, reversed in 0, and inconclusive for SmolLM3’s preference stage and Qwen3.5-4B ( Table 3 ). Replies are standardized for every user, but the update that produces them treats varieties differently.
blocks.zh: 受欢迎的家庭也指出了同样的方式。 在14个进一步更新中(在受欢迎家庭的最后发布基准,以及SmolLM3的偏好阶段),12年的调整对比是正数,0年倒数,而SmolLM3的偏好阶段和Qune3.5-4B(表3)则没有定论。 答复对每个用户都是标准化的,但产生答复的更新对品种的处理不同.

blocks.en: 5.2 Added Preference Pairs Raise Convergence Only at the Largest Dose Tested
blocks.zh: 5.2 添加的首选对等只提高最大剂量的趋同度

blocks.en: Dialect-bearing prompts are rare in the released preference data. Only 0.81% of the prompts in the OLMo-2-7B preference mix and 0.64% in Tülu-3’s trigger the dialect recognisers ( Section C.2 ), so the selectivity arises from few dialect-bearing pairs.
blocks.zh: 在公布的偏好数据中很少出现有发音的提示. OLMo-2-7B偏好组合中只有0.81%的音符,Tülu-3的0.64%触发了方言识别器(C.2节),因此选择性来自极少的有方言的对子.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Added pairs raise convergence only at the largest dose, by different amounts across runs. Convergence on (a) held-out and (b) trained features by added pairs; mean ± \pm std over runs; dashed: released DPO.
blocks.zh: 图5:增加的对子仅在最大剂量时,按不同剂量的跨度提高趋同率。 合并(a) 被搁置和(b) 被附加对子训练的特性; 平均 ±\pm std 运行; 破折: 发布 DPO。

blocks.en:
Adding accommodation-consistent pairs raises convergence only at the largest dose we tested. We re-ran DPO from the released OLMo-2-1B SFT checkpoint with its recipe on a fixed subset of its preference mix, adding pairs whose chosen reply is the AAE or Singlish rendering of the rejected standard reply; matched controls add the same number of standard pairs ( Figure 5 ; Table 17 ).
At 1k (0.8% of pairs, about the natural share), 5k and 20k added pairs (14%), held-out convergence stays at its dose-0 level and matches the controls (20k: 0.001, CI [ − - 0.002, 0.004]).
At 60k (33%; added after pre-registration), held-out convergence rises above the control in all 4 training runs, by different amounts (0.090, 0.023, 0.030 and 0.027, each with a CI above zero; 0.043 on average, CI [0.032, 0.058]). The gain transfers to the held-out varieties (0.035 on average), and IFEval stays within the pre-registered two-point bound (prompt-level accuracy 57.9% over the 4 runs, against 59.1% at dose 0 and 58.2% for the matched controls).
blocks.zh:
加入符合住宿要求的对子,只会在我们测试的最大剂量下提高趋同度. 我们从已发布的OLMo-2-1B SFT检查点重新发送了DPO,其配方位于其首选组合的固定子集上,增加了对子,其选择的答案是AAE或Singlish渲染被否决的标准答复;相匹配的控件增加了同样数量的标准对子(图5;表17)。
在1k(0.8%的对子,大约为天然份额)时,5k和20k相加的对子(14%),被搁置的趋同会停留在剂量-0的水平上并符合控制(20k:0.001,CI [−-0.002,0.004)].
在60克(33%;在预先登记后加上),所有4次训练中,被搁置的趋同率都高于控制,数额不同(0.090、0.023、0.030和0.027,每起CI高于0;平均0.043,CI [0.032、0.058])。 向被搁置品种的增益转移(平均为0.035),而IFEval则停留在预先登记的双点约束范围内(4个跑道的速率精确度为57.9%,而相应控制为0和58.2%)。

blocks.en: The added pairs raise convergence without calibrating it. In all 4 runs at 60k, Standard-English replies gain 0.10–1.06 trained dialect features per 100 words (controls: 0.00); Singlish replies carry 1.07–9.47 times the user’s trained-feature rate, AAE replies only 0.17–0.47 times. Preference data can raise convergence, but only at a dose far above the share of dialect-bearing prompts, unevenly across runs, and without calibration to the user.
blocks.zh: 所添加的对子在不校正的情况下提升了趋同. 在所有4个运行时间为60k时,标准-英语回复每100个单词获得0.10–1.06个训练有素的方言特征(控制:0.00); Singlish回复带1.07–9.47倍用户训练有素率,AAE回复只有0.17–0.47倍. 偏好数据可以提高趋同度,但只有在远高于有方言的提示的分量时,横行不均,且不对用户进行校正.

blocks.en: 5.3 Sensitivity Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.3 敏感性分析

blocks.en: The findings hold under other analysis choices. Changing one choice at a time (estimator, bootstrap, reply length, sampling seeds, human-audit correction) leaves both findings in place ( Table 19 ; details in Section C.4 ).
blocks.zh: 调查结果属于其他分析选择。 一次改变一个选择(估计器、靴子、答复长度、取样种子、人审计校正)留下了两个结果(表19;详情见C.4节)。

blocks.en: 6 Calibrated Accommodation Pairs
blocks.zh: 6个校准住宿配给

blocks.en: This section introduces calibrated accommodation pairs and tests whether they make models match their users without imposing dialect.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍校准的住宿配对,并测试它们是否在不强加方言的情况下使模型与用户相匹配.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Calibrated accommodation pairs. The model’s reply r 0 r_{0} to the Standard-English twin is rendered at the user’s density ( M M ) and in every sentence ( F F ). DPO pairs prefer M M over r 0 r_{0} and over F F for a dialect user, and r 0 r_{0} over F F for a Standard-English user.
blocks.zh: 图6:校准的住宿配对。 该模型对标准英语双胞胎的回答r 0r_{0}在用户密度(M M)和每句(F F. DPO配对偏好M M 而不是 r 0 r_{0}和 F F F 对于一个方言用户, r 0 r_{0} 相对于 F F 对于一个标准英语用户.

blocks.en: The re-run raises convergence without calibrating it ( Section 5.2 ): Standard-English replies gain dialect features, Singlish is over-produced and AAE under-produced. We turn this diagnosis into a recipe for preference data.
blocks.zh: 重新运行提高了趋同度,但没有校正它(第5.2节): 标准-英语回复获得方言特征,Singlish被过度生产,AAE被低估. 我们把这种诊断变成一种偏好数据的配方。

blocks.en: Calibrated accommodation pairs (CAP) re-render the model’s own reply r 0 r_{0} to a request’s Standard-English twin with the trained features only ( Figure 6 ). For a dialect request, M M renders r 0 r_{0} at the trained-feature density closest to the user’s, at most 1.25 times it. U pairs prefer M M over r 0 r_{0} , O pairs prefer M M over F F , a rendering with features in every sentence, and, for the Standard-English twin, A pairs prefer r 0 r_{0} over F F . These pairwise preferences penalize under-accommodation, over-accommodation and imposition, without guaranteeing calibrated generation. The pairs (U : O : A = 2 : 1 : 1 =2:1:1 ) make up a third of the DPO data, the share at which one-sided pairs raised convergence; held-out features and varieties test transfer.
blocks.zh: 校准的住宿配对(CAP)将模型本身的答复r 0r_{0}重新交给只具有训练有素特征的标准-英语双人(图6). 对于方言请求, M M 使 r 0 r_{0 } 在最接近用户的训练程度密度, 最多为1. 25 倍。 U对比r 0r_{0},O对比M更偏好M 而非F F F,这是每个句子中带有特征的渲染,对于标准-英语双胞胎,A对比r 0r_{0}胜过F F. 这些双向优惠惩罚住宿不足、过度住宿和强加,而不保证适中一代。 相对(U:O:A=2:1:1=2:1:1:1)占DPO数据的三分之一,是单相对提高趋同度的比例;所持出地特征和品种试验转让.

blocks.en: 6.1 Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: 6.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We train OLMo-2-1B, whose stages are all released and whose controls carry over from Section 5.2 , at a fixed budget per arm, against a control preferring one standard reply over another and the one-sided pairs; the test set is 300 fresh requests from a disjoint pool ( Table 11 ).
blocks.zh: 我们训练OLMo-2-1B,其各个阶段全部解除,其控制从第5.2节转到每个臂的固定预算,对照一个控制偏好一个标准答复,而不是另一个标准答复和单侧对;测试集是300个新请求,来自一个脱节池(表11)。

blocks.en: Criteria frozen before any result ( Section B.3 ): held-out convergence at least 0.02 above the control (M1); calibration closer to the user’s density than the one-sided recipe, without insertion (M2); tracking of a within-request density intervention (M3); IFEval within two points (M4); compliance with requests for Standard English (M5).
blocks.zh: 在取得任何结果之前冻结的标准(B.3节):在控制(M1)以上至少0.02分之间保持趋同;比单面配方更接近用户密度的校正;不插入(M2);跟踪请求内密度干预(M3);2分之内的IFEval(M4);遵守对标准英语(M5)的要求。

blocks.en: The pre-declared pilot passed 3 of 4 validation checks but under-accommodates; we continued as pre-declared, without tuning ( Section B.5 ).
blocks.zh: 预先申报的试点通过4个鉴定检查中的3个,但评分不足;我们继续作为预先申报,不作调试(B.5节).

blocks.en: 6.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 6.2 主要结果

Without the A pairs, convergence barely moves (0.008); fine-tuning on the mirrored replies instead of preferring them leaves it unchanged ( − - 0.001): the gain comes from the preference contrast. blocks.en: CAP’s held-out gain holds under a request-only bootstrap, without the false-positive exclusion, and on the requests of Section 4 (0.137; Section B.5 ).

blocks.en: On the lineage whose every stage is released, CAP raises held-out convergence with no detectable increase in dialect for Standard-English users; one-sided pairs built the same way reach a similar gain only by overshooting the user and imposing it.
blocks.zh: 在每一个阶段都被释放的血统上,CAP提高被搁置的收缩,对于标准英语用户来说,方言没有可察觉的增加;单相对造型相同,只能通过过度射击和强制使用达到类似的收益.

blocks.en: 7 Discussion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论情况

blocks.en: Output audits find one Standard-English answer for every user; the update diagnostic, read from public checkpoints without retraining, shows training moving the policy toward matching some users and away from others. Model releases should report it next to output audits. The standard default arises with little dialect-specific data (under 1% of preference prompts) and is not inevitable, since deployed chatbots answer Nigerian Pidgin in kind. The prestige ordering in the update is consistent with prestige-directed convergence but does not identify prestige as its cause, and raw and adjusted contrasts answer different questions, so update diagnostics should report both ( Section C.3 ).
blocks.zh: 产出审计为每个用户找到一个标准英语的答案;更新的诊断从公共检查站读取,而不进行再培训,显示培训将政策推向匹配一些用户,而不是其他用户。 模型发布应在产出审计旁边报告。 由于部署的聊天员以实物方式回答尼日利亚语 Pidgin, 更新过程中的威望顺序与以威望为导向的趋同一致,但并未将威望确定为其原因,原始和调整后对比解答了不同的问题,因此更新后诊断结果应同时报告(C.3节.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en:
Along every released stage of open model lineages, post-training standardizes replies to every informal cue, prestige spelling included, while the training update favours matching prestige spelling over stigmatized varieties, and models still produce AAE features on request; adding accommodation-consistent pairs to a third of the DPO data raises held-out convergence over matched controls in every run, though without calibrating it.
Calibrated accommodation pairs address that failure: on OLMo-2-1B they raise held-out convergence with no detectable increase in dialect for Standard-English users, though explicit requests for Standard English still receive some, whereas one-sided pairs built the same way reach a similar gain only by overshooting the user’s density and imposing it.
Uniform replies can hide a selective update; audits should read the update as well as the output.
blocks.zh:
在开放的模范线条的每一个发布阶段,培训后对每一个非正式提示的答复进行标准化,包括声望拼写,而培训更新则倾向于将声望拼写比作污名品种,而且模型仍然应要求产生AAE特征;在DPO数据的三分之一中添加符合住宿的对子,提高了每次运行时对相配控制所持的趋同性,尽管没有校正。
校准的住宿配对解决了这一故障:在OLMo-2-1B上,它们提高阻滞的趋同度,对标准英语使用者的方言没有可察觉的增加,尽管对标准英语的明确要求仍然收到一些,而单侧配对只通过过度射击用户密度和强迫其增加而达到类似收益。
统一的答复可以隐藏有选择地更新;审计应读取更新和产出。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: We study English, six varieties and open lineages up to 32B whose every stage is public; closed chatbots enter only through their behaviour. All requests are rule-based renderings that are not calibrated to the feature densities of authentic text, so convergence on real users’ writing may differ; only competence and a check on human-written AAE twins ( Section C.1 ) are anchored in authentic text. Our detectors cover a finite feature inventory, and human validation rests on consensus labels for a sample of 84 items, which the part-of-speech formality score failed and the GYAFC-trained ranker passed; the CAP and WildChat checks are consensus labels on samples too, with no independent double annotation, so inter-annotator agreement is not reported.
blocks.zh: 我们研究英语,6个品种和长达32B的开放线条,每个舞台都是公开的;封闭的聊天员只能通过他们的行为进入. 所有请求都是基于规则的渲染,不适应正版文本的特征密度,因此在真实用户的写作上的趋同可能有所不同;只有能力,对人写的AAE双胞胎的检查(C.1节)被固定在正版文本中. 我们的探测器覆盖一个有限的特征清单,人类验证依赖于84个样本的协商一致标签,部分语序分数失败,GYAFC训练分数通过;CAP和WildChat检查也是样本上的协商一致标签,没有独立的双注,因此没有报告通知人之间的协议。

blocks.en: The update diagnostic describes what each stage favours on content-matched replies, not why: we did not train the released models, and the preference-data audit is correlational. Our causal re-run uses OLMo-2-1B, and its effect appears only at the largest dose we tested and varies across training runs. On OLMo-2-1B, CAP passes M1 and M4 but fails M2, M3 and M5, and on Qwen3-8B it does not pass M1 ( Section B.3 ); the prestige contrast pairs spelling cues with grammatical and lexical dialect features, so it does not separate social prestige from feature type; it is tested with rendered requests and trained-feature targets, and it under-accommodates. We measure asymmetry, not optimal behaviour; whether and when a model should reply in a user’s variety is for its speakers to decide ( Sandoval et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 最新诊断描述了每个阶段对内容匹配的答复的偏好,而不是为什么:我们没有训练释放的模型,偏好数据审计是相关的. 我们的因果再运行使用OLMo-2-1B,其效果只出现在我们测试的最大剂量,并且随着训练运行而变化. 在OLMo-2-1B上,CAP通过M1和M4但失败了M2,M3和M5,在Qune3-8B上,它没有通过M1(B.3节);威望对比的拼写提示带有语法和地语方言特征,因此它不会将社会威望与地物类型区分开来;通过提供的请求和训练有素的特质目标进行测试,它不够和谐. 我们衡量不对称,而不是最佳行为;一个模型是否以及何时应该以用户的多种形式答复,应由其发言者决定(Sandoval等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: We use public corpora under their licences ( Section A.2 ). Some licences are non-commercial or share-alike, and we redistribute no raw corpus text. Personal data in authentic texts are masked before any display, and WildChat requests are used only where its release flags no personal data. Synthetic dialect text is labelled as synthetic and is never presented as authentic speech.
blocks.zh: 我们使用公共公司 许可证(A.2节)。 有些许可证是非商业的或类似于股票的,我们不重新分配原始的文字。 作准文本中的个人数据在任何显示前都会被蒙上面具,而WildChat请求只有在其发布旗上没有个人数据的情况下才被使用. 合成方言文字被标为合成文字,从未被呈现为正文.

blocks.en: Code and data are here for research https://github.com/kouzhizhuo/cap-accommodation : the variety-twin requests and their renderings with their validity gates, the feature detectors, the analysis and re-run code, the human labels of the audits (the 20 WildChat items by their WildChat identifiers, without their text) and all derived results. The replies of the deployed chatbots will be released subject to the providers’ terms. Corpora whose licences do not state redistribution (the AAE tweets and EnDive) are not re-shared; the code release includes scripts that rebuild their twins from the original sources. We do not release the re-trained checkpoints.
blocks.zh: 这里的代码和数据是用于研究 https://github.com/kourzhizhuo/cap-control: 品种-twin请求及其渲染及其有效性门,特征探测器,分析和再运行代码,审计的人类标签(20个WildChat项目用他们的WildChat识别器,没有文字)以及所有衍生结果. 已部署的聊天组的答复将根据供应商的条件发布。 其许可没有声明再分配的Corpora(AAE的微博和EnDive)没有重新共享;代码发布包括从原始来源重建双胞胎的脚本. 我们不释放经过再训练的检查站。

blocks.en: No crowdworkers or external participants were involved. All human labels are consensus labels from a panel of five or more annotators with PhD-level training in related fields, agreed through discussion; an author recorded them with a software tool. They cover a blind audit of 84 items of model-generated text, a blind sample of 20 WildChat user requests and 40 replies in the blind CAP naturalness check ( Section 6 ). The items were not annotated independently, so no inter-annotator agreement is reported. No other human labels exist, and any LLM labels are reported as such.
blocks.zh: 没有群众工作者或外部参与者参与。 所有人类标签都是通过讨论商定的、由五个或五个以上在相关领域接受博士级培训的注释员组成的小组的共识标签;一位作者用软件工具记录这些标签。 其中包括对84个模型生成文本的盲目审计,20个WildChat用户请求的盲目样本,以及盲CAP自然性检查中的40个答复(第6节)。 这些项目没有独立说明,因此没有报告通知人之间的协议。 没有其他人类标签,任何LLM标签都报告为此类.

blocks.en:
Accommodation is not a quantity to maximize: over-accommodation can caricature and stereotype ( Fleisig et al., 2024 ) , and Black American participants want choice ( Sandoval et al., 2025 ) .
Our re-run shows that a large dose of accommodation-consistent preference pairs switches accommodation on, and that in one of 4 runs it over-produces the trained features, which risks caricature.
blocks.zh:
住宿不是最大限度的:过度住宿可以讽刺和刻板印象(Fleisig等,2024年),美国黑人参与者希望有选择(Sandoval等,2025年)。
我们的再运行显示,一大批符合住宿要求的一对优先选择搭配开通了住宿,在四对优先选择搭配中,一对超量生产出训练有素的特征,这有漫画风险。

blocks.zh: AI助手被用于代码书写和抛光,但整个研究都是由研究人员设计和检查的.

blocks.en: The 287 first-person requests span six task types (advice, creative, how-to, opinion and small talk, 50 each; explanation, 37) and carry a context tag (150 formal, 137 casual). Each request is rendered in every condition with its content fixed. Morphosyntactic features are applied by Multi-VALUE ( Ziems et al., 2023 ) with each feature’s eWAVE attestation weight scaled by 0.8 and restricted to a per-variety whitelist; lexis, discourse particles and spelling come from curated lexicons; informal and formal Standard English and the spelling varieties use rule sets of their own. The transforms are not calibrated to authentic feature densities, and the renderings were not rated for naturalness (see Limitations). The sister request of Section 1 ( v1s002 ) received three transforms: no third-person -s ( keep ), a dropped auxiliary have ( been canceled ) and y’all .

blocks.en:
This section describes the feature detectors, the blind human audits and the LLM judges.
Detectors are rule-based recognisers over spaCy parses and curated word lists. Each feature is counted against its opportunities, the sites where the standard variant occurs and the feature could apply. Morphosyntactic features ported from Multi-VALUE are checked against its synthetic gold spans on 8,000 Dolly-15k sentences: a feature is counted only if it reaches recall 0.70 and precision 0.85 at equal numbers of positives and negatives, on at least 30 gold spans. The 13 features that pass reach recall 0.81–1.00, precision 0.99 or more and false-positive rates of at most 0.9%; copula absence (recall 0.23) and no third-person -s (0.52) fail. Features without a Multi-VALUE transform are checked on author-written positive and near-miss cases. Clause gating and the false-positive check of Table 9 decide which features are counted.

blocks.en:
The labels for 84 blind items, drawn stratified at random by script (seed 20261004), are consensus labels from a panel of five or more annotators with PhD-level training in related fields, agreed through discussion and recorded by an author with a software tool; no inter-annotator agreement is reported. Gwet’s AC1 between the consensus labels and each automatic measure (the agreement rows of Table 10 ): 0.204 and − - 0.062 for the part-of-speech score on shown texts and full replies, 0.63 for the GYAFC ranker, and 0.896 for feature presence in requested replies. Items show no model, stage, condition, variety or score, and replies are trimmed to about 80 words. The author chose every label without AI assistance and a software agent typed the choices into the sheet; the author attests that no answer was suggested. An earlier returned sheet was filled by an LLM agent; it is not used and not reported as human. The decision rules were written before any label existed. There are three item families.
(i) 40 formality pairs: SFT replies of OLMo-2-7B and OLMo-3-7B to the same request, one to a vernacular user (AAE, Singlish or Nigerian Pidgin) and one to an equally informal Standard-English user, stratified by terciles of the score difference; the panel picks the more formal reply or “about the same”.
(ii) 30 requested replies of OLMo-2-7B and Tülu-3-8B after DPO, one feature per item, half detector-positive where available; the panel says whether the feature occurs.
(iii) 14 default replies of aligned models to AAE and Singlish users, all detector-positive. Table 10 gives the results.

Gwet的AC1在协商一致的标签和每个自动措施之间(表10的协议行):0.204和--0.062,在所显示的文本和完整答复上对部分言论的分数,GYAFC的分数为0.63,在所要求的答复中,特征存在为0.896。 物品没有显示模型,舞台,条件,品种或分数,答复被修剪为约80个字. 作者在没有AI协助的情况下选择了每一个标签,一个软件代理将选择打入了工作表;作者证明没有提出答案. 较早返回的一张工作表由LLM剂填入;没有使用,也没有报告为人. 裁决规则是在任何标签存在之前制定的。 有三品眷属.
(一) 40个形式对:OLMo-2-7B和OLMo-3-7B对同一请求的SFT答复,一个答复给一个方言用户(AAE、Singlish或尼日利亚语Pidgin),一个答复给同样非正式的标准-英语用户,用特克西来分解得分差;面板选择更正式的答复或“大致相同”。

blocks.en:
The part-of-speech formality score is not validated; the formality ranker is. The panel judged 25 of 40 pairs equally formal. On the other 15, the Heylighen and Dewaele (2002) score of the shown texts picked the panel’s choice in 9 ( κ = 0.196 \kappa=0.196 , bootstrap 95% CI [ − 0.316 , 0.700 ] [-0.316,0.700] ), and the score of the full replies in 7. This is below the pre-declared bar, so the register result is reported only in Section D.2.1 . The GYAFC-trained formality ranker that the protocol had named ( Rao and Tetreault, 2018 ; Babakov et al., 2023 ) , run after labelling, picks the panel’s choice in 12 of 15 pairs on the shown texts ( κ = 0.59 \kappa=0.59 ) and in 12 on the full replies, which clears the bar; the register result uses the ranker ( Section D.2.1 ). The detectors agree with the panel on requested replies, with too few hits to clear the precision bar. The panel confirmed 6 of 7 detector hits and found the feature in 1 of 23 detector-negative items ( κ = 0.814 \kappa=0.814 , CI [ 0.510 , 1.000 ] [0.510,1.000] ; AC1 = 0.896 =0.896 , CI [ 0.719 , 1.000 ] [0.719,1.000] ). Precision exceeds .80, but its lower bound is below .60. As pre-declared, competence is therefore reported at the human-corrected rate, precision times detector rate ( Section 4.2 ).
The single unconfirmed hit is a Singlish feature, completive finish , which our pre-registration keeps descriptive only. Neither audited Singlish feature ( can / cannot as an answer, completive finish ) enters the Singlish competence score, which uses particles and lexis, so that score has no human check. The descriptions of these two features were drafted for the audit and used without the planned review. Restricted to the retained AAE features that the protocol specifies, the panel confirmed all 6 hits (lower bound 0.610). We chose this restriction after labelling, so it is a sensitivity analysis and does not change the decision. Detector hits on default replies are noisy. The panel confirmed 6 of 14 hits: all 4 for ain’t and 2 for completive done , but none of the 4 for multiple negation or the 4 for completive finish . Real features are rare in these replies, so precision among hits is low even at the per-reply false-positive rates of the validity gate. The aligned-stage convergence these counts feed is near zero ( Section 4.1 ).
Fewer detector-positive items than planned existed for can / cannot , completive finish and completive done ; per-item provenance, shortages and the scoring script are in the code release ( https://anonymous.4open.science/r/cap-accommodation/ ).

blocks.en: Two open-weight LLMs from different families, openai/gpt-oss-20b and Qwen/Qwen3-8B , labelled the same 84 items blind, with the panel’s instructions and options, a fixed prompt and greedy decoding (prompt and settings in the code release). On the 40 register pairs, the judges call 3 and 0 pairs equally formal, against the panel’s 25; where the panel picked a reply, gpt-oss-20b picked the same one in 14 of 15 pairs and Qwen3-8B in 12 of 15. The two judges agree with each other on 33 feature items and 30 register pairs. The judges ran after the human labels were in, and no validation rule or reported effect uses their labels.

blocks.en: B.3 Calibrated Accommodation Pairs
blocks.zh: B.3 校准住宿配给

blocks.en: This section gives the CAP setup, its pre-declared criteria, pair construction and training details.
blocks.zh: 本节提供CAP的设置,其预先宣布的标准,配对构造和培训细节.

blocks.en: Analysis code and criteria were frozen before any result (D24, in the code release). M1: held-out convergence above the control by at least 0.02 with a 95% CI above zero, from a bootstrap over training runs and requests. M2: per variety, a reply-to-user density ratio closer to 1 than the one-sided recipe’s, fewer replies above twice the user’s density, and at most 0.05 inserted features per 100 words for Standard-English users. M3: a positive within-request tracking slope, above the one-sided recipe’s. M4: IFEval within two points, on the CI. M5: no more dialect than the control under a request for Standard English. Before training, an audit found no held-out features in the pairs and length or punctuation differences of one to two words in opposite directions across pair types; only 0.39 of the mirrored replies land within 25% of the user’s density, 1.9 features below it on average, because many replies offer too few sentences to render, and the over-dense replies are also less fluent under the SFT model (0.18 nats per token). • U , against under-accommodation: a dialect request; chosen, the reply re-rendered at the user’s density (the subset of sentences whose achieved density is closest to the user’s, at most 1.25 times it); rejected, the standard reply. • O , against over-accommodation: the same request; chosen as in U; rejected, every sentence re-rendered, kept only with at least twice the chosen reply’s features. • A , against imposition: the Standard-English twin; chosen, the standard reply; rejected, every sentence re-rendered. The mix is U : O : A = 2 : 1 : 1 =2:1:1 over AAE and Singlish, at a third of the DPO pairs ( Figure 6 , Section 6 ). Candidates carry only the trained features, so held-out features and varieties test transfer.
blocks.zh: 分析代码和标准在任何结果之前被冻结(D24,代码发布中). M1:从训练运行和请求的靴子上,至少以0.02的阻断趋同,95%的CI高于零。 M2:每个品种,比单面食谱更接近1的回复-用户密度比,超过用户密度两倍的回复较少,标准-英语用户每100个字最多可插入0.05个功能. M3:在单面配方之上, M4:IFEval在两分之内,在CI上. M5:没有比标准英语请求下的控制更多的方言. 在培训之前,审计发现对等和对等的长度或相向一至两字的相向差异没有被搁置的特征;只有0.39个反射的回复在用户密度的25%范围内着陆,平均低于1.9个特征,因为许多回复给出的句子太少,在SFT模式下,过于紧张的答复也不太流利(每令牌0.18纳特)。 · U,反对住宿不足:一种方言请求;选择时,答复按用户密度重发(其达到的密度最接近用户密度的子集,最多为1.25倍);拒绝标准答复。 • O,反对过度住宿:要求与U相同;被否决,每一句都重新提出,只保留了所选答复的至少两倍。 二. 支助 A,反对强制:标准-英语双胞胎;选择,标准回复;拒绝,每句重发. 混音为: U: O: A = 2: 1: 1: 1: 1 胜于AAE和Singlish,为DPO配对的三分之一(图6, 第6节.). 考生只携带训练有素的特质,因此被搁置的特质和品种测试转让.

blocks.en: An expert panel assigned consensus labels to 84 blind items ( Table 10 in Section B.2 ). On requested replies, the consensus labels and detectors agree on 28 of 30 items ( κ = 0.814 \kappa=0.814 ), and the panel confirmed 6 of 7 detector hits. The GYAFC-trained formality ranker that the protocol named, run after labelling, picks the panel’s more formal reply in 12 of 15 pairs; the part-of-speech score does not pass (9 of 15), and no claim rests on it. On raw user requests the recognisers over-fire: of 18 WildChat requests they flagged, the expert panel confirmed 3. We therefore apply them only to model replies. Default replies carry few hits, and the panel confirmed 6 of 14; the false ones, mostly multiple negation (confirmed in 0 of 4), occur about as often in replies to the Standard-English twins (146 against 121 hits over 30,996 replies each after post-training), so they largely cancel in the ratio, and default convergence remains subject to this detector error ( Section B.2 ). Prior function-word measures barely move between varieties and stages, and instructions, personas and copying do not explain the pattern ( Section C.1 ).
blocks.zh: 一个专家小组为84个失明物品划定了协商一致的标签(B.2.节表10)。 根据要求的答复,协商一致的标签和探测器商定30项中的28项(=0.814\kappa=0.814),小组确认了7项探测器命中中的6项。 GYAFC训练的正版分牌由协议所命名,按照标签进行,在15对分中的12对中选择了小组更正式的回答;部分分数没有通过(15分中9分),没有索赔依据. 在原始用户请求时,识别器过火:在他们标出18个WildChat请求中,专家小组确认3个。 因此,我们只对答复范本加以适用。 默认答复的点击率很少,小组确认了14分之6;假答复大多是多重否定(在4分之0中确认),在对标准-英语双胞胎的答复中(146分对121次点击数超过30 996分的答复,每分在训练后,每分每分30 996分),因此它们基本上取消了比例,默认趋同仍然受制于这一探测器错误(B.2节)。 先前的功能字措施几乎无法在品种和阶段之间移动,说明书、人物和复制无法解释模式(C.1节)。

blocks.en: B.5 Further CAP Details
blocks.zh: B.5 联合呼吁程序的进一步细节

blocks.en: Settings, pilot, registered criteria, ablations and sensitivity of Section 6 in full.
blocks.zh: 第6节的设置、飞行员、注册标准、拼接和敏感性。

blocks.en: CAP’s pairs express preferences against sampled under- and over-accommodation; we do not claim a reward that peaks at the user’s density. The three pair types do different work: the matching and anchoring contrasts carry the gain, the over-accommodation contrast buys restraint, and density matching curbs the Singlish overshoot ( Section 6.3 ).
blocks.zh: CAP的一对表示对抽样的住宿不足和过度的偏好;我们不主张在用户密度上达到顶峰的奖励。 三种对接类型做不同的工作:匹配和锁定对比带增益,超住宿对比带增收约束,密度匹配能抑制Singlish过度射击(第6.3节).

blocks.en: We train OLMo-2-1B, whose stages are all released and whose controls from Section 5.2 carry over, with a fixed budget in every arm ( Table 11 in Section B.3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们培训OLMo-2-1B,其阶段全部解除,第5.2节的管制延续,每个臂都有固定的预算(B.3节表11)。

blocks.en: Table 11: CAP is tested at a fixed budget against matched controls. Arms share prompts and pair counts.
blocks.zh: 表11:联合呼吁程序在固定预算中对照相应的控制措施进行测试。 武器共享提示和对数

blocks.en: The test set is 300 fresh requests from a pool disjoint from training, validation and the requests of Section 4 .
blocks.zh: 测试组有300个新请求,来自一个与培训、验证和第4节请求脱节的池。

blocks.en: We compare CAP with a control that prefers one standard reply over another and with the one-sided pairs of Section 5.2 , at the same budget, and, without training, with the unchanged model ( Table 11 ).
blocks.zh: 我们把联合呼吁程序与一个更倾向于一个标准答复而不是另一个标准答复的控制,与同一预算第5.2节的单面对数进行比较,并在没有培训的情况下,与不变的模式进行比较(表11)。

blocks.en: The pre-declared pilot on OLMo-2-1B passed 3 of 4 checks on validation requests. Its trained-feature convergence exceeds the control by 0.38 (CI [0.35, 0.41]), and it inserts no dialect into replies to Standard-English users ( − - 0.002 features per 100 words against the control). Its calibration falls below the pre-declared band: CAP under-accommodates, reproducing 0.50 of the user’s density for AAE and 0.26 for Singlish, as the audit of its pairs anticipated ( Section B.3 ). We continue as pre-declared, without tuning on the pilot.
blocks.zh: 在OLMo-2-1B上预先宣布的试运行者通过了4个验证请求中的3个. 其训练有素的地貌趋同超过控制0.38(CI [0.35,0.41]),并在对标准-英语用户的答复中插入了没有方言(---0.002个特征每100个单词与控制相对抗). 它的校正低于预先宣布的波段:CAP under-accomates,按照对其配对的审计(B.3节)的设想,复制0.50的用户密度为AAE,0.26为Singlish. 我们继续作为预先宣布的,没有调整飞行员。

blocks.en: Its AAE replies stay as far below the user’s density as the one-sided pairs’ (0.17 against 0.18 of it), and its Singlish replies no longer overshoot (0.79 against 2.59); the Singlish difference is not resolved, because the one-sided runs vary widely, so M2 fails as registered. The one-sided pairs track the user’s Singlish density more steeply, by overshooting it (slope 3.606 against 0.191; M3 fails), and neither recipe makes the 1B model follow a request for Standard English (0.680 and 0.954 more features per 100 words than the control; M5 fails).
blocks.zh: 它的AAE回复远远低于用户的密度,如单面对等(0.17对0.18),而其Singlish回复不再过量(0.79对2.59);Singlish的差异没有被解决,因为单面运行大相径庭,所以M2未能如登记的那样成功. 单面对子通过过度射击来更陡峭地跟踪用户的Singlish密度(slope 3.606对0.191;M3失败),而两个配方都使得1B模型都遵循标准英语的要求(每100个单词比控制多0.680和0.954个特性;M5失败).

blocks.en: Each ablation removes one component of CAP on OLMo-2-1B at the same budget: the O pairs (their slots filled with U pairs), the A pairs, the preference contrast itself (SFT on the mirrored replies, then DPO on control pairs), and density matching (the one-sided pairs of Section 5.2 , and, as a pre-declared control for their older pair builder, the same recipe built with CAP’s builder); an exploratory run raises the mirror target to 1.5 times the user’s density.
blocks.zh: 每一次减价都会在同一预算中去掉OLMo-2-1B上的CAP的一个组件:O对(其槽中填满了U对),A对,偏好对比本身(SFT在镜像答复上,然后DPO在控制对上)和密度相匹配(第5.2节的单侧对接,以及作为对其更年长的造对者预先宣布的控制,与CAP的建对者所建的相同配方);探索跑将镜像目标提升到用户密度的1.5倍.

blocks.en: Table 5 isolates the O pairs. Without them, held-out convergence rises to 0.583 over the control (2 runs), but the model imposes dialect: replies to Standard-English users gain 0.039 features per 100 words, and replies to a request for Standard English keep 7.36. The O pairs thus trade convergence for restraint, the behaviour CAP is built to keep; the registered one-sided pairs gain less (0.043) and insert more (0.560). Imitation is not enough: fine-tuning on the same mirrored replies before DPO leaves held-out convergence unchanged ( − - 0.001) and costs − - 5.9 IFEval points, so the gain comes from the preference contrast. Within CAP’s mix, the A pairs matter as much: without them, held-out convergence barely moves (0.008, 2 runs). The mirror target sets how far CAP accommodates: raising it to 1.5 times the user’s density, in an exploratory run, multiplies held-out convergence by 2.0 (0.340) without insertion ( − - 0.007). Density matching is what curbs the overshoot, although AAE replies remain well below the user’s density. Built with CAP’s builder, the one-sided pairs raise held-out convergence by 0.201 (CI [0.139, 0.269], 2 runs), a gain similar to CAP’s, but by overshooting: their Singlish replies reach 10.41 times the user’s density, 95% of them above twice it (CAP: 0.79, 0%), replies to Standard-English users gain 0.378 features per 100 words, and replies to a request for Standard English keep 2.42.
blocks.zh: 表5隔离了O对. 没有它们,被搁置的趋同在控制(2跑)上上升到了0.583个,但模型强制了方言:对标准英语用户的回复每100个单词得到0.039个特征,对标准英语保持7.36的要求的答复. 因此,O对交易趋同以保持克制,行为CAP是用来保存的;注册的单面对得分减少(0.043)并插入更多(0.560)。 模仿是不够的:在DPO保留被搁置的趋同(---0.001)和成本(-- 5.9 IFEval points)不变之前,对相同的镜像答复进行微调,所以收益来自于偏好对比. 在CAP的组合中,A配对同样重要:没有A配对,被搁置的趋同几乎不会动(0.008,2跑). 镜像目标设定了CAP的可容纳度:在探索性运行中,将其提升到用户密度的1.5倍,将所持有的收缩相乘以2.0(0.340)而无需插入(−-0.007)。 密度匹配是遏制过度射出的方法,尽管AAE回复仍然远远低于用户密度. 由CAP的构建者所建,单相对能将被搁置的收缩提升0.21(CI [0.139,0.269],2跑),这一收益与CAP相似,但通过过度射击:他们的Singlish回复达到用户密度的10.41倍,其中95%高于两倍(CAP:0.79,0%),对标准英语用户的回复达到每100个字0.378个特性,以及对标准英语保留2.42的要求的答复.

blocks.en: CAP’s held-out gain on OLMo-2-1B does not depend on how it is estimated or where it is tested. A bootstrap over requests alone narrows its interval to [0.151, 0.198] (registered, over runs and requests: [0.138, 0.207]); dropping the 2% false-positive exclusion leaves it at 0.173; and on the 287 requests of Section 4 , used before the method existed, it is 0.137 (CI [0.108, 0.167]).
blocks.zh: CAP对OLMo-2-1B的持有收益不取决于如何估计或测试地点. 单是请求的后缀就缩小到[0.151,0.198](登记、超运行和请求:[0.138,0.207]);将2%的虚假阳性排除值降至0.173;在方法存在之前使用的第4节的287项请求中,是0.137(CI [0.108,0.167])。

blocks.en: We also ran 5 lineages (OLMo-2 at 1B, 7B and 13B, OLMo-3-7B and Tülu-3-8B) on real dialect text paired with Standard-English versions: 225 AAE tweets with human Standard-English translations ( Groenwold et al., 2020 ) , each with at least one retained AAE feature, and 500 AAE and 500 Singlish items of EnDive ( Gupta et al., 2025 ) , translated by an LLM from Standard-English benchmark prompts. Harness, detectors and estimators are those of the main runs. A pair is excluded if either reply refuses (a phrase rule on the first 300 characters); for OLMo-2-7B after DPO this removes 22% of the tweet pairs, and the replies to the Standard-English tweets refuse more often (17%) than those to the AAE tweets (12%). After post-training, convergence to the human-written AAE is near zero, at most 0.017 at any post-trained stage ( Table 16 ), as for constructed twins. Before it, convergence depends on the framing, again as for constructed twins: it is near zero under the transcript scaffold and clearly positive under raw continuation and the chat template. Our pre-declared test of standardization on human-written AAE therefore meets its first condition (near-zero convergence after DPO) on all 5 lineages and its second (below the base model under every framing) only on OLMo-2-13B, so both hold on 1 of the 4 lineages with a base model; Tülu-3-8B’s base is gated. We use no recogniser-selected WildChat requests as dialect input ( Section C.2 ).

blocks.en:
We ran the retained-feature recognisers over the prompts of the released preference mixes of OLMo-2-1B, OLMo-2-7B and Tülu-3-8B. A prompt counts as dialect-bearing if it contains at least one realization of a retained morphosyntactic feature of AAE or Singlish. The shares are 0.81%, 0.81% and 0.64%; on the human-written Dolly-15k instructions, a proxy for the false-positive floor on plain English, the same recognisers fire on 0.03% of prompts. On 162,842 first user turns of WildChat-1M ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) (English, non-toxic, not redacted, 20–300 words, no code or URLs), the AAE recognisers fire on 0.50% and the recognisers of Singlish particles and words on 0.04%. In a blind check of 18 sampled hits, the expert panel confirmed 3 of 13 AAE hits (2 of 2 for ain’t , 1 of 11 for multiple negation) and 0 of 5 Singlish hits, and found the feature in none of 2 unflagged controls. The rejected hits are mostly templated creative-writing prompts, code and names. On chat text, false positives thus far exceed the Dolly floor, which understates them, and the shares above overstate real dialect use (AAE in WildChat: about 0.12%, 95% CI 0.04–0.25%). We therefore use no recogniser-selected WildChat requests as dialect input. The shares are not exhaustive: the recognisers cover only retained features, and in a check of eight sampled hits by an LLM agent, at most two were dialectal, the others being answer templates (“or not”) or tokenization artefacts (“gon na”).
The mix used for OLMo-2-32B reuses the 7B mix’s prompts with completions from the 32B family; its dialect-bearing share is 0.81% (7B: 0.81%). On AAE-bearing prompts, chosen and rejected replies differ in AAE density by − - 0.006 (CI [ − - 0.024, 0.009]; 87% ties) against − - 0.007 (CI [ − - 0.022, 0.005]; 87% ties) for 7B. These are correlational descriptions of the data, not tests of what the update learns.
blocks.zh:
我们在OLMo-2-1B、OLMo-2-7B和Tülu-3-8B的放出偏好组合的提示上运行保留地识别器。 如果它至少包含一个对AAE或Singlish保留了的形态学特征的实现,那么即时算作有方言. 持股率为0.81%、0.81%和0.64%;根据人文Dolly-15k指令,普通英语上的假阳性地板的代名词,同一识别器向0.03%的提示点火。 在162,842 WirdChat-1M(Zhao等,2024年)(英语,无毒,未编辑,20-300字,无代码或URL)的首个用户转会中,AAE识别器以0.5 %起火,Singlish粒子和单词识别器以0.04%起火. 在对18起抽样打击的盲目检查中,专家小组确认了13起AAE打击中的3起(2起不是2起,11起是多起否定)和5起Singlish打击中的0起,并在2起未悬挂标记的控制中没有发现这一特征。 被拒绝的点击大多是模板化的创作-写出提示,代码和名称. 在聊天文字上,假阳性迄今已超过多利地层,该地层低估了它们,上面的股份也过多地反映了真实方言的使用(WildChat中的AAE:约0.12%,95%CI 0.04–0.25%). 因此,我们没有使用识别器选择的 WildChat 请求作为方言输入。 股份不是详尽无遗的:识别器只涵盖保留特征,在对一个LLM代理的8个抽样点击的检查中,最多有两个是方言,其他是回答模板(“或不是”)或象征性的手工艺品(“gon na”)。
OLMo-2-32B使用的混音重用由32B家族完成的7B混音符;其含方言的比例为0.81%(7B:0.81%). 在含AAE的提示上,所选择的和被拒绝的答复在AAE的密度上,以−-0.006(CI [−-0.024,0.009;87%的领带)与−-0.007(CI [−-0.022,0.05;87%的领带)为7B。 这些是数据的相关描述,而不是测试更新学到了什么.

blocks.en:
We initialize from allenai/OLMo-2-0425-1B-SFT and train with the released DPO recipe in open-instruct (length-normalized loss, β = 5 \beta=5 , learning rate 2.5 × 10 − 6 2.5\times 10^{-6} , one epoch, 128 pairs per step) on a fixed, seeded 120k-pair subset of the released 1B preference mix; this is dose 0. Added pairs come from a disjoint pool of first-turn requests (Dolly-15k, OASST1). The prompt is rendered in AAE or Singlish using only the training split of the features. blocks.en: An audit that inspects replies finds the same Standard-English answer for every user and cannot tell whether training treats varieties alike. The update diagnostic shows that it does not: it moves the policy toward matching some users and away from matching others. This preference does not show in the default output, and content-matched reply pairs read it from public checkpoints without retraining. We recommend that model releases report it next to output audits when consecutive checkpoints are public.
blocks.zh: 检查答复的审计为每个用户找到相同的标准-英语答案,无法判断培训是否对品种一视同仁. 更新的诊断表明它没有:它将政策转向匹配一些用户,而远离了匹配其他用户. 这种偏好并不表现在默认的输出中,内容匹配的回函对子在没有再培训的情况下从公共检查站读取. 我们建议,当连续的检查站公开时,在产出审计之后,示范发布报告。

blocks.en: Convergence falls at the preference stage on data in which fewer than 1% of prompts carry a detectable dialect feature, and the ability to produce AAE features on request survives. The default is thus consistent with the form that general post-training data favour, in line with the mostly stylistic shifts that alignment tuning produces ( Lin et al., 2024a ) . Deployed chatbots that answer Nigerian Pidgin in kind ( Section 4.1 ) show that standardizing a stigmatized variety is not inevitable after post-training. Accommodation-consistent preference pairs raise convergence, though without calibration to the user ( Section 5.2 ), and some capacity to produce the features remains accessible on request.

blocks.en: CAT predicts convergence toward prestige. After alignment, the replies of our models show little convergence of any kind, but after adjustment the updates of all 10 lineages still favour matching prestige spelling over stigmatized varieties, and the ordering of behaviour by prestige is already present at the base checkpoints. The ordering is consistent with prestige-directed convergence but does not identify prestige as its cause. Raw and adjusted contrasts answer different questions: OLMo-2-32B’s update up-weights unlikely replies in general, so its contrast is − - 0.031 on the observed pairs and 0.012 after adjustment, and diagnostics of an update should report both. blocks.en: D.1 Theory and Pre-Registered Hypotheses

blocks.en: This section states the theory we test and the hypotheses we pre-registered.

blocks.en: Table 20: Every pre-registered CAT construct has a measurable counterpart on model replies. The CAT construct, the quantity we measure ( Section 3 ), and the hypothesis it tests.
blocks.zh: 表20:每个预先登记的CAT构件在模型答复上都有可衡量的对应数据。 CAT构造,我们测量的数量(第3节),以及它测试的假设.

blocks.en:
CAT holds that speakers adjust their speech to their interlocutors for social reasons ( Giles et al., 1991 ; Giles, 2016 ) . Convergence reduces linguistic differences to seek approval or affiliation; divergence accentuates them to mark distinctiveness or status; and maintenance keeps one’s own variety.
Three tenets make the theory testable on language models ( Dragojevic et al., 2016 ) .
❶ Convergence is asymmetric and flows upward, toward the higher-status variety.
❷ Over-accommodation , meaning caricatured or patronizing convergence, is perceived as demeaning.
❸ Psychological accommodation (intent) differs from linguistic accommodation (the forms produced), so a speaker may be able to converge and choose not to.
Mechanistic accounts instead derive convergence from largely automatic priming ( Pickering and Garrod, 2004 ) , though lexical entrainment can be partner-specific ( Brennan and Clark, 1996 ) . A pretrained model continuing a user turn is such a priming device.
The two accounts therefore make different predictions for language models: priming predicts convergence to every variety, while CAT predicts convergence that depends on the social value of the variety. We use CAT only as a source of such predictions; we make no claim about model intentions.

禁止酷刑委员会认为,由于社会原因,发言者对对话者的发言进行调整(Giles等人,1991年;Giles,2016年)。 趋同会减少语言差异以寻求批准或从属关系;差异会突出其特征或地位;维护会保持自己的多样性。
三条原则使得该理论在语言模型上可以被验证(Dragojevic等,2016.
❶ 趋同是不对称的,向上流动,走向地位较高的品种.
❷ 过度住宿,意为漫画或优雅的趋同,被认为是贬义。
❸ 心理通融(意向)与语言通融(所出形式)不同,因此演讲者可能可以聚集并选择不相通.
机械化的叙述则取而代之的是基本上自发地取向(Pickering and Garrod, 2004.)的趋同,尽管从字法上讲,可以针对具体伙伴(Brennan and Clark, 1996.)。 一种预先训练的模型继续一个用户转弯,就是这种发火装置。
因此两种说法对语言模型作出不同的预测:平分预测与每种品种的趋同,而CAT预测的趋同则取决于品种的社会价值. 我们只使用CAT作为这种预测的来源;我们不声称模式意图。

blocks.en:
Standard-language ideology holds that one variety is correct and that the others are errors ( Milroy, 2001 ; Milroy and Milroy, 2012 ) . Institutions reproduce it by rewarding the standard ( Lippi-Green, 2012 ) . Its stigma falls on racialized and postcolonial speakers even when they use standard forms ( Rosa and Flores, 2017 ) , and matched-guise experiments measure it as covert evaluation from speech alone ( Lambert et al., 1960 ; Hofmann et al., 2024 ) . Smith et al. (2026) argue that generative AI reproduces this ideology; we measure it.
Under the ideology, upward convergence has a predictable shape. Models should converge to the standard and to prestige cues, including an informal but standard register. They should maintain or diverge from stigmatized morphosyntax, which the ideology classes as “wrong grammar”. And they should keep the competence to produce it.

在意识形态下,向上趋同具有可预期的形态. 模型应该与标准和声望一致,包括一个非正式但标准的登记册。 他们应该保持或偏离被污名化的形态语法,意识形态阶级称之为“错误语法”。 他们应该保留制作它的能力。

blocks.en:
Accommodation is measured as style matching in word use ( Niederhoffer and Pennebaker, 2002 ; Ireland and Pennebaker, 2010 ) , as the coordination of style markers ( Danescu-Niculescu-Mizil et al., 2011 ; Danescu-Niculescu-Mizil et al., 2012 ) , or as baseline-corrected lexical and syntactic alignment ( Nenkova et al., 2008 ; Doyle et al., 2016 ; Duran et al., 2019 ) ; these measures are sensitive to low-level confounds such as utterance length ( Xu et al., 2018 ; Litterer et al., 2025 ) .
Language models converge strongly when completing human dialogues, and instruction-tuned models converge less ( Blevins et al., 2026 ) ; deployed chat models over-converge to their users’ style in the wild ( Blevins, 2026 ) , although convergence in human–ChatGPT dialogue declines over turns ( Mitiaeva and Xiao, 2026 ) .
LLM replies match their partners’ style less than humans do ( Durandard et al., 2025a ; Durandard et al., 2025b ) and entrain less than therapists ( Kian et al., 2025 ) ; alignment also depends on the interlocutor, falling below human levels with children though not with adults ( French et al., 2024 ) and better for higher socioeconomic groups ( Bassignana et al., 2026 ) .
Models also favour tokens seen in the context, even irrelevant ones ( Niu et al., 2025 ; Kukreja et al., 2026 ) , which a convergence measure must discount as copying.
Unlike these works, which measure style, we measure the features that distinguish varieties —spelling, register and dialect grammar—at every released post-training stage, and we separate what the model does from what its update favours.
blocks.zh:
住宿被测量为文字使用中的样式匹配(Niederhoffer和Pennebaker,2002年;爱尔兰和Pennebaker,2010年;),作为样式标识的协调(Danescu-Niculescu-Mizil等,2011年;Danescu-Niculescu-Mizil等,2012年;),或作为基线校正的词汇和综合校正配对(Nenkova等,2008年;Doyle等,2016年;Duran等,2019年;这些措施对低层次的混杂体敏感,如发音长度(Xu等,2018年;Litter等,2025年)。
语言模型在完成人类对话时会强烈地趋同,而教学调整模型的趋同程度会降低(Blevins等,2026年);在野外对用户的风格部署聊天模式过度凝聚(Blevins,2026年),虽然人类-ChatGPT对话的趋同程度会下降(Mitiaeva和Xiao,2026年).
LLM的回复与其伴侣的风格相匹配不如人类(Durandard等人,2025年a;Durandard等人,2025年b;与治疗师的内分泌相匹配(Kian等人,2025年b;校正也取决于对话者,虽然与成年人不同,但低于人类水平(法国等人,2024年)),对于更高的社会经济群体来说更好(Bassignana等人,2026年)。
模型还倾向于从上下文来看的标志,甚至无关的标志(Niu等,2025;Kukreja等,2026),而趋同措施必须视同为复制。
与这些测量风格的作品不同的是,我们测量每个发布后训练阶段中区分品种的特征——拼接,注册和方言语法,我们把模型的工作与它的更新偏好区分开来.

blocks.en:
Post-training is associated with reduced output diversity ( Kirk et al., 2024 ; Padmakumar and He, 2024 ; West and Potts, 2025 ; Gude et al., 2026 ) , which has been traced to typicality bias in preference data ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) and located in particular post-training stages ( Karouzos et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . On the superficial-alignment view, models learn the format of replies from little fine-tuning data ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) , and alignment tuning shifts mostly stylistic tokens ( Lin et al., 2024a ) .
Direction matters as much as variance: AI writing suggestions pull Indian writers toward Western styles ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ) , LLM rewriting erases South Asian English markers ( Bharati et al., 2026 ) , and chat models answer speakers of other varieties in a “standard” variety ( Fleisig et al., 2024 ) .
Homogenization predicts that replies vary less; we test a directed shift instead, in which replies to every informal cue move toward one standard at both fine-tuning stages, in line with the superficial-alignment view, while the update is not variety-neutral.
blocks.zh:
后培训与产出多样性的减少有关(Kirk等,2024;Padmakumar和He等,2024;West and Potts,2025;Gude等,2026),这追溯到偏好数据中的典型偏好(Zhang等,2025a),并特别位于后培训阶段(Karouzos等,2026;Li等,2026). 从表面对齐的角度来看,模型从很少微调的数据中学习出答案的格式(周等,2023年),对齐的调动多为花样活字(林等,2024a. 。 。 。 。
方向与差异同样重要:AI写作建议将印度作家引向西方风格(Agarwal等,2025年),LLM重写抹去南亚英语标记(Bharati等,2026年),聊天模型以"标准"品种回答其他品种的说者(Fleisig等,2024年).
同源化预言,答复的差别较小;我们测试的是定向转变,在这种转变中,对每一个非正式提示的答复都按照表面对齐的观点,在两个微调阶段向一个标准移动,而更新并非品种中立。

blocks.en:
Reward models disprefer African American Language and steer conversations toward White Mainstream English ( Mire et al., 2025 ) ; across the pipeline, dialect gaps accumulate and reward-model preferences between dialect versions of a problem change sign across tasks ( Elle, 2026 ) ; preference tuning creates disparities between English dialects ( Ryan et al., 2024 ) ; and reward models are weaker outside English ( Gureja et al., 2025 ) .
Preference models also reward surface form: length ( Singhal et al., 2024 ) , lists, bold text and emojis ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) , and human and LLM judges rate fluent answers above factually correct ones ( Wu and Aji, 2025 ) ; preference-tuned models also defer to users’ views ( Sharma et al., 2024 ) .
Unlike these studies, which score fixed texts with a reward model or judge, we read the policy’s own update on content-matched replies that differ only in whether they match the user’s variety.
blocks.zh:
奖励模式不利于非裔美国人语言,引导对话向白人主流英语方向发展(Mire等,2025年);跨管道,方言差距会累积和奖励模式偏好于方言版本的问题改变标志跨任务(Elle,2026年;优惠调整会造成英语方言之间的差别(Ryan等,2024年;奖励模式在英语之外较弱(Gureja等,2025年)。
偏好模型也奖励表面形态:长度(Singhal等,2024年),列表,粗体文字和emojis(Zhang等,2025年b),人和LLM评委将流利的答案评分高于事实正确的答案(Wu和Aji,2025年;偏好调整模型也服从用户的意见(Sharma等,2024年).
与这些以奖励模式或法官评分固定文本的研究不同的是,我们阅读了政策本身对内容匹配的答复的更新,这些答复仅在是否与用户的种类相匹配方面有所不同。

blocks.en:
Direct preference optimization makes the log-ratio between policy and reference an implicit reward ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) , interpretable at the token level ( Rafailov et al., 2024 ) , and reward benchmarks evaluate it alongside explicit reward models ( Lambert et al., 2025 ) . As a reward model it generalizes less well than an explicit one ( Lin et al., 2024b ) , and preference-tuned models often fail to rank preferred responses above rejected ones ( Chen et al., 2024 ) .
Differences between a tuned and an untuned model’s log-probabilities also isolate what fine-tuning adds and can transfer it across scales ( Mitchell et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) .
We use the ratio descriptively, as an update diagnostic : comparing it across content-matched replies shows which reply forms a training stage up- or down-weights given the user’s variety. We do not treat it as an identified reward, and we read the SFT-versus-base ratio as a likelihood shift only.
blocks.zh:
直接优惠的优化使政策与参考之间的对账比率成为隐含的奖励(Rafailov等,2023年),在象征性层面可以解释(Rafailov等,2024年),奖励基准与明确的奖励模式一起评估(Lambert等,2025年)。 作为奖励模式,它概括起来不如明确模式(Lin等人,2024年b),优惠调整模式往往不能将首选答复排在被拒绝的答复之上(Chen等人,2024年)。
调制模型和未调制模型的对数概率之间的差异也隔离出微调添加哪些内容,并可在尺度之间转移(Mitchell等人,2024;Liu等人,2024)。
我们以描述性的方式使用这个比率作为最新的诊断:在内容匹配的答复中进行比较,就用户的种类而言,这些答复构成一个培训阶段。 我们不把它视为一种确定的奖励,我们把SFT对-基比看成只是概率转移.

blocks.en:
Standard-language ideology treats one variety as correct and others as errors ( Milroy, 2001 ; Lippi-Green, 2012 ) ; sociolinguistics distinguishes monocentric from pluricentric languages, whose national varieties have their own norms ( Clyne, 1992 ) , and postcolonial Englishes can develop endonormative standards ( Schneider, 2003 ) . Recent work argues that generative AI reproduces this ideology ( Smith et al., 2026 ; Ugwuanyi, 2026 ) .
The fairness literature documents its costs: covert dialect prejudice revealed by matched-guise probing ( Hofmann et al., 2024 ) and by paired dialect–standard comparisons ( Bui et al., 2025 ) , which human-feedback alignment conceals rather than removes ( Hofmann et al., 2024 ) and side-by-side comparison amplifies ( Kondapally et al., 2026 ) ; dialect-dependent safety behaviour ( Haq and Saldaías, 2026 ) ; harms that must be named against a normative standard ( Blodgett et al., 2020 ) ; and adaptation labour shifted onto speakers ( Cunningham et al., 2024 ) .
Speakers want control over when a variety is used: Black American participants prefer Mainstream U.S. English in formal settings and are more open to AAE in informal ones ( Sandoval et al., 2025 ) , and preferences differ between text and spoken AAE chatbots ( Finch et al., 2025 ) .
Our results are consistent with, but do not by themselves establish, a monocentric standard in post-training. They give sociolinguists a test of accommodation theory with machine interlocutors, alignment researchers a diagnostic of what preference data teach beyond content, and auditors a way to separate what a model does from what its training favours.
blocks.zh:
标准语言意识形态将一种品种视为正确,将其他种类视为错误(Milroy,2001;Lippi-Green,2012;社会语言学将单一中心语言与多中心语言区分开来,其民族品种有自己的规范(Clyne,1992)),以及后殖民时代. 英语人可以制定捐助标准(Schneider,2003.). 近期的著作认为,遗传性AI复制了这种意识形态(Smith等,2026;Ugwuanyi,2026.).
公平文献记录了成本:通过配对的检验(Hofmann等,2024年)和配对的方言-标准比较(Bui等,2025年)暴露出隐蔽的方言偏见,人食后坐配隐藏而非去除(Hofmann等,2024年)和并肩比较放大(Kondapally等,2026年);依赖方言的安全行为(Haq和Saldaías,2026年);必须按规范标准命名的伤害(Blodgett等,2020年);适应劳动转移到演讲者身上。 (Cunningham等, 2024).
发言者想要控制在何时使用多种语言: 美国黑人参与者在正式场合更喜欢主流美国英语,在非正式场合对AAE更开放(Sandoval等,2025年),文字和口语AAE聊天机器人的偏好不同(Finch等,2025年).
我们的成果与培训后的一个单一中心标准是一致的,但其本身并不确立。 他们给社会语言学家一个与机器对话者的住宿理论测试, 给研究人员一个诊断 哪些偏好数据教的超出内容, 以及审计师一个方法 来区分一个模型做什么 与它的培训偏好。
